tools.name: ask_user
tools.description: Ask the user a question and wait for the answer. Use it only when you cannot continue without their decision; it waits as long as needed, hours or days. Offer choices when there are natural options; the user can also type a free-text answer unless you set allow_text to false. The result is {"choice": ..., "text": ...}, or {"timeout": true} if timeout_seconds passed without an answer.

tools.name: delegate
tools.description: Hand a self-contained piece of work to a sub-conversation of the same user and get its result. task: what to do; brief: what it needs to know (it does not see this conversation); wait: true (default) waits for the result, false returns at once and the result is reported back here later. The sub-conversation can read memory but only add notes; at most two levels deep.

tools.name: history_search
tools.description: Search this user's past conversations word for word, including parts that were compacted or left the context. Returns the matching lines with their session and time. Use it when memory_search finds nothing.

tools.name: memory_delete
tools.description: Delete one of your memory entries by name, for example when the user asks you to forget something.

tools.name: memory_note
tools.description: Note one thing worth remembering for this user. kind: preference | fact | decision | noticed; text: one sentence; quote: the user's exact words that show it (needed for it to count as what the user said). Use memory_write instead to write or rewrite a whole entry.

tools.name: memory_read
tools.description: Read the full body of one of your memory entries by name (see the memory index).

tools.name: memory_search
tools.description: Search this user's memory (entries and daily notes) by keywords; results show where each came from. Words like 'three days ago' or '上周' narrow the dates. If nothing is found, try other words or another language before saying you do not know.

tools.name: memory_write
tools.description: Save a long-term memory for this user (new, or overwrite the entry with the same name). name: [a-z0-9-]; type: user, feedback, project, reference; description: one line shown in the index; content: Markdown body.

tools.name: now
tools.description: Your working memory for this user: what you are doing (task), what was promised (commitment), what you are waiting for (waiting), what you noticed (noticed). action: list | add (kind, text; optional next, to, due, on, and quote: the user's exact words if they asked for it) | update (id, version; any of text, status, next, to, due, on) | close (id, version; status done or dropped). Status is active, waiting, done or dropped. A stale version is refused with the current one; read it and try again.

tools.name: read_attachment
tools.description: Read a file the user attached, by its read-only path (/attachments/sha256-...). Images are shown to you. Text is cut at 2000 lines or 50 KB, whichever comes first; read in parts with offset and limit.

tools.name: todo_write
tools.description: Record and update a structured task list for the current work. Send the ENTIRE list every call: it REPLACES the previous list (there are no partial updates, no per-item edits). Use it to plan multi-step work and show progress: add one todo per concrete step before you start. Keep exactly one todo in_progress while work remains. Mark a todo completed the moment it is done (do not batch completions). Skip the list for trivial single-step tasks. Statuses: pending (not started), in_progress (being worked on now), completed (finished).

description.en: Before a command runs on your computer (bash or PowerShell), shows it on the conversation page and waits: allow, allow all commands in this session, or deny. Commands run as you, without a sandbox.
description.zh: 在你的电脑上跑命令（bash 或 PowerShell）之前，先在对话页上给你看这条命令并等你决定：允许、这个会话都允许，或者拒绝。命令以你的身份运行，没有沙箱。
description.ja: コンピューターでコマンド（bash または PowerShell）を実行する前に、会話ページにそのコマンドを表示して判断を待ちます。許可、このセッションでは常に許可、拒否から選べます。コマンドはあなたとして実行され、サンドボックスはありません。

description.en: Recall what is relevant from memory before the model answers.
description.zh: 回答前从记忆里想起相关的。
description.ja: 回答の前に、記憶から関係のあることを思い出します。

hint.en: After each turn, note what is worth remembering in today's notes.
hint.zh: 每轮结束后，把值得记住的写进当天的笔记。
hint.ja: 毎回の終わりに、覚えておく価値のあることを今日のメモに書きます。

description.en: Replaces API keys, tokens, passwords and private keys in tool results with [REDACTED] before the model, the record and the page see them.
description.zh: 工具结果交给模型、写进记录、显示在页面上之前，把里面的 API key、令牌、密码和私钥换成 [REDACTED]。
description.ja: ツール結果をモデル・記録・ページに渡す前に、API キー、トークン、パスワード、秘密鍵を [REDACTED] に置き換えます。
